description.text: Heatran VS Regigigas, a Japanese Versus Starter Pack released on 14 March 2008, the same day as the expansions Cry from the Mysterious and Temple of Anger. Its two ready-built 30-card half decks are led by Heatran and Regigigas, and the box always held two Pokémon LV.X, Gliscor LV.X in the Heatran deck and Mewtwo LV.X in the Regigigas deck, so players could learn the Level-Up rule while they played. Damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book came with it.
